feature_encoding: Position-specific one-hot encoding of the frozen 30-column alignment using a fixed 20-residue-plus-gap alphabet.
selectivity_prediction: GCGR prediction minus GLP-1R prediction; no separately fitted selectivity target.
outer_evaluation: Exactly the frozen cluster-intact outer folds in data/derived/outer_folds.csv.
inner_selection: Leave one training-only sequence component out; minimize the unweighted mean of component-level, two-receptor MAE.
component_weighting: Within every fit, each training sequence component has equal total weight; records within a component share that weight equally.
